summary: TRACK 14.0-ELITE-OPS-B 5:30 AM iPad usability audit of 9 workflows. Validated login (multi-login), portal SSO holds across /admin /pm /safety-portal /shop /dispatch-portal /field-leadership (no login redirects, no token clears), W3 PM Command Center loads at /pm/command-center, W6 FL portal loads with correct FL chrome (not admin chrome), W1 Incidents list renders 54 rows with stable safety-* nav testids and back nav returns to /safety-portal/incidents. KEY FRICTION FOUND + FIXED: three intuitive URLs returned 404 (/safety-portal/meetings, /admin/daily-reports, /admin/trench-safety-assets). Added router redirects so tired 5:30 AM users typing the natural URL land on the working page instead of a 404. After fix: Meetings dashboard (42 meetings, New Meeting CTA visible), HR Daily Reports Review (200 reports, filter form), and Trench Equipment list (21 assets, Quick Add CTA) all render correctly via the redirect aliases.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED — /safety-portal/meetings, /admin/daily-reports, /admin/trench-safety-assets all returned 404. Added redirects to /admin/meetings, /hr/daily-reports, /safety/trench-safety/assets respectively in App.js. A 5:30 AM superintendent typing the natural URL no longer hits a dead end.

FRICTION (by design, but worth a 5:30 AM tooltip): incidents list has NO 'New Incident' CTA. The header copy says 'New incidents are submitted from the field at /incidents/new'. That's a hyperlink but the visual weight is low — a tired PM looking at this list will scan for a button and feel lost. Recommend adding a secondary outline button labelled 'Submit Field Incident →' that links to /incidents/new even though this is the read-only review surface.

iter509 flag still standing — /admin/unified-directory route does NOT exist (404). HR portal /hr loads but landing page has no <input> for the directory search; the global Search appears to be a modal triggered by Cmd+K only. The 'search by name' contract a foreman would expect on the HR landing screen is not directly visible.

integration_issues.issue: First post-login session captured ~20+ 'Failed to load resource: status 401' console errors across the PM/Safety/Incidents traversal. Re-run with response-listener saw 0, so they may be one-shot at initial token fan-out. Worth confirming the Ferrari migration eliminated ALL 401 storms on cold-cache PM Command Center load (the doctrine line in TRACK_14_RC1_FERRARI_CLOSURE.md).

action_items: VERIFY my router redirects in /app/frontend/src/App.js (3 new <Route> lines at the legacy redirects block around line 981) match house conventions; consider promoting them to canonical routes instead of redirects if the natural URL is truly the one a user expects.
Add a 'Submit Field Incident →' secondary CTA on /safety-portal/incidents header — currently the only way is parsing the body copy hyperlink, which a 5:30 AM user will miss.

Resolve the HR directory search testid gap (iter509 carry-over). Add a top-of-page <input data-testid='hr-directory-search'> on /hr landing OR on a sub-route /hr/directory; today the only path to search is the Cmd+K global modal.
Audit one cold-cache PM Command Center load with devtools network and confirm the early-burst 401s I saw on first run are truly post-Ferrari expected (token bootstrap) and not regressions.

Exercise the W7 (safety meeting conductor+attendees+PDF) and W8 (JobPicker + QR png_data_url + deployment history) full round-trip — those were unrun by me due to token budget; the previous closure docs should be re-cert-tested before sign-off.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 1083+ lines and growing — recommend splitting the route table into /app/frontend/src/routes/*.jsx per portal (admin/pm/safety/hr/shop/dispatch/fieldLeadership/public) to make the iPad-usability audit pattern-matchable in future iterations.

The 404 NotFound page is well-built (testid='not-found-page' + per-portal links), but the fact that 3 intuitive URLs in this audit's RoE landed there proves the legacy-redirect block isn't keeping up with the URL surface a real human types.
